summary: The requirement document asks for a platform where small-business loan applicants apply online and on a mobile app, and the credit team reviews and approves applications. It covers identity checks, bank statement reading, bureau score and rules-based scoring, e-sign, e-NACH, payments and dashboards, with three years of support.
